_note: Generated hairstyles (decision 0008): each image is outfit-01's with 'Bald.' swapped for the hairstyle, in vivid emerald green so the hair separates from skin and clothes by colour (the game recolours it). Each style is split into a front piece (everything in front of the ears) and a back piece; chains are spring-bone chains fitted along hair that hangs free; squeeze draws a flared style in below the eyes and curl turns its ends under (hair_tools.tame); blunt cuts the fringe straight across (hair_tools.blunt_cut); thin draws a voluminous style in towards the scalp (hair_tools.thin); below_chin cuts it straight across that far under the chin.
